_comment: OVERLAY, not a full config. `nanobot onboard` generates the real ~/.nanobot/config.json (~500 lines of defaults). This file documents only the keys Clawrophyll changes -- apply them by hand to the onboarded file. Schema verified against nanobot's onboarded output. Do NOT commit the filled-in copy; secrets stay on the board.

gateway._comment_heartbeat: Phil's sense-and-decide loop runs on the heartbeat. Default is 1800s (30 min); we use 3600s (hourly) -- a plant changes slowly and the heartbeat runs on the agent's model (Opus, no per-job override), so the interval is the cost lever. Sam can still message Phil for an on-demand check anytime. Changing this needs a nanobot restart.

mcpServers._comment_phil_hardware: HTTP/SSE transport: the MCP server runs inside the App Lab container (started via `arduino-app-cli app start ~/ArduinoApps/clawrophyll`). The container exposes port 8765 to the host loopback (see app.yaml `ports`). Schema confirmed against nanobot's MCPServerConfig.
